# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Over sixty  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c1 P9](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0009), [v1 c38 P0](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Aunt Thirza  <sub>[v1 c8 P8](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0008), [v1 c8 P12](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0012)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a tall, slender frame characterized by sharp angles rather than curves. Her dark hair is streaked with gray and constantly bound in a tight, firm bun at the back, held combatively by a pair of wire hairpins. She has a sallow, stern face, though a redeeming twitch around her mouth indicates a hidden sense of humor.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 c14 P46](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0046)_

## Personality

Thirza gives the impression of an unyielding sense of morality, strict discipline, and extreme cleanliness, often speaking in a sharp, abrupt, and rigid manner. She dislikes excessive chatter, daydreams, vanity, unromantic silliness, and untidiness. Despite her stern exterior and insistence on propriety, she possesses a hidden sense of humor, a deep capacity for compassion, and an unexpected warmth that grows into strong affection for those in her care. Once she makes up her mind on a course of action, she maintains a firm and stubborn determination.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c3 P63](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0063), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c5 P21](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0021), [v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c9 P9](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0009), [v1 c10 P13](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0013), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c11 P8](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0008), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083)_

## Goals

- To raise and train Nell Harcourt into a practical, dutiful, and proper young lady  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c12 P7](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0007)</sub>
- To maintain proper order and morality at Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P8](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0008), [v1 c7 P14](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0014)</sub>

## History

Thirza resides at Grey Shutters with her brother Obed Abernethy. Expecting an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist on the farm, she is shocked when Obed returns from the train station with an eleven-year-old red-haired girl named Nell Harcourt instead. Though initially determined to send Nell back due to her uselessness on a farm and her loquacious, overly imaginative nature, Thirza develops sympathy for the child's deprived background and agrees to take her in permanently. Thirza takes charge of Nell's upbringing, attempting to curb her excessive imagination, instill religious education, and teach her practical duties like dishwashing, sewing, and bedmaking. When neighbor Agatha Sowerby insults Nell's appearance and triggers a fiery outburst, Thirza punishes Nell by confining her to her room until she apologizes, while surprisingly defending Nell to Agatha. Later, Thirza wrongly accuses Nell of stealing her treasured amethyst brooch; when the brooch is found caught in a shawl, Thirza realizes her mistake and reconciles with Nell. When Nell falls ill from a sprained ankle after walking a roof ridgepole, Thirza realizes how deeply she has come to love her foster daughter. Later, Thirza goes to Port Marlow to hear the Canadian Premier speak, leaving Nell and Obed at home. After Obed dies suddenly from a heart attack caused by the failure of the Abbey Bank, Thirza faces the loss of their life savings and contemplates selling Grey Shutters, but Nell refuses to let the home go and chooses to stay and teach at the Brierley school instead of attending college. Thirza's eyesight deteriorates, requiring a doctor's order to stop reading and sewing, prompting her to invite the widowed Agatha Sowerby to live with her at Grey Shutters so Nell can finally attend Wexcombe College. Years later, Thirza witnesses Nell's graduation with High Honors and her marriage to Hugh Carrow in the orchard of Grey Shutters.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Brierley and was considered a dark, homely child by an aunt  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- In her youth, she was in love with John Carrow, but broke off their connection after a quarrel because she refused to forgive him in time  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Lived at Grey Shutters into adulthood with her brother Obed Abernethy  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P31](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0031)</sub>
